captions.detailed: An entry-level external-cable dropper seatpost, consisting of a lower black outer post sleeve and an upper black inner sliding post. A black rubber collar boot seals the joint between the two telescoping cylinders. At the top of the inner post is a flat black mounting bracket holding two parallel silver saddle rail clamps. Near the bottom of the outer sleeve, a small mechanical cable bracket with a lever pivot is attached, with a black actuation cable extending downward.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an external-cable dropper seatpost. It should feature a lower outer sleeve, a telescoping inner sliding post with a rubber boot at the transition, a two-bolt saddle rail clamp assembly at the top, and an external cable actuator pivot bracket near the bottom with an attached actuation cable.
captions.factory: Construct the outer post sleeve and inner post using concentric Cylinder primitives. Model the rubber boot at the transition with a slightly wider cylinder. For the saddle clamp, extrude a rectangular base block on top of the inner post, and add two parallel cylindrical rail clamps. Create the external cable actuator by joining a small box bracket on the side of the lower sleeve and extending a thin cylinder downward to represent the actuation cable.
